reason: Mnemon primarily provides persistent cross-session memory and knowledge-graph recall for AI agents, with runtime-specific hooks and skills for lifecycle integration.

summaries.zh: Mnemon 为 AI 智能体提供基于知识图谱的持久化跨会话记忆、召回与记忆写入能力。
summaries.en: Mnemon provides AI agents with persistent cross-session memory, knowledge-graph recall, and supervised memory writeback.

capabilities: Persistent local storage of agent memories and knowledge graphs
Recall and write memory through remember, link, and recall operations
Installation of skills, prompts, hooks, and extensions into supported agent runtimes
Modification of project-local or user-level runtime configuration
